claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows signs of use and dust on the iron body.
The report identifies an electric iron but does not show whether it is a dry iron or a steam iron.
Whether the iron heats up is not shown.
Photos cannot show the seller's location.

risks.risk: The iron does not heat up or is electrically faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the iron switched on with the soleplate heating up.

risks.risk: The power cord and three-pin plug are worn, damaged, or unsafe.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cord and plug plus a continuity test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing cord or plug replacement.

risks.risk: The wattage or voltage rating is unsuitable for Lagos supply.
risks.proof: Close-up of the rating label on the iron.

risks.risk: Age is unknown and the item may be near end of life.
risks.proof: Photo of a manufacturing date label or original receipt.

risks.risk: No original box or warranty is included.
risks.proof: Photo of the box and warranty documents.

proof_requests: Video of the iron switched on and heating.
Close-up of the rating label showing wattage and voltage.
Close-up of the power cord and three-pin plug.
Photo of any original box or warranty.
response.reason: The witness identifies a used electric iron, so it can be valued at its worst case as an untested unit with a worn cord; proof of heating and a safe cord would raise the value.
